sections.heading: B — Audience and scope
sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning required and prohibited vehicle equipment, the periodic safety inspection, and the condition and maintenance checks for brakes, lamps, signals, exhaust, steering, tires, belts and windshields in plain English.

Prerequisites: basic vehicle vocabulary such as muffler, antilock brakes and tread; this chapter assumes no earlier chapter.

Scope note: required equipment, prohibited lights and noise devices, the yearly safety inspection and its exceptions and paperwork, and the maintenance checks for brakes, lamps, signals, latches, exhaust, horn, mirrors, belts and child restraints, air bags, steering, tires and windshields. Registration and titles follow in the next section.

Recall emphasis: inspection intervals, child restraint thresholds, steering free play and tread depth are practiced as recall items; no scenario or recognition surface is needed for this section.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the required and prohibited vehicle equipment, the periodic safety inspection, and the condition and maintenance checks for brakes, lamps, signals, exhaust, steering, tires, belts and windshields rules on pages 18–20 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
